protocol: Fit per-view isotropic orthographic scale from neck-to-ankle vertical span and translation from neck projected position; no shape changes. Calibration is nuisance registration, not recovered physical camera. Back calibration independent of pose optimization.

front.horizontal_anchor: neck only, leaving ankle horizontal discrepancy for pose test
front.vertical_anchors: neck and mean ankle heights; same fixed170cm shape prior
front.annotation_uncertainty: Manual neck-base location under hair/near collar and ankle centers under cuffs uncertain by several pixels; not detector or observed-person measurements
front.role: camera calibration only; back is excluded from shared-pose training

side.horizontal_anchor: neck only, leaving ankle horizontal discrepancy for pose test
side.vertical_anchors: neck and mean ankle heights; same fixed170cm shape prior
side.annotation_uncertainty: Manual neck-base location under hair/near collar and ankle centers under cuffs uncertain by several pixels; not detector or observed-person measurements
side.role: camera calibration only; back is excluded from shared-pose training

back.horizontal_anchor: neck only, leaving ankle horizontal discrepancy for pose test
back.vertical_anchors: neck and mean ankle heights; same fixed170cm shape prior
back.annotation_uncertainty: Manual neck-base location under hair/near collar and ankle centers under cuffs uncertain by several pixels; not detector or observed-person measurements
back.role: camera calibration only; back is excluded from shared-pose training
